name: Kazunori Toru
source:
Vocal Range: Medium-High
Job: Voice Actor

His scary and expressionless face often cause people to avoid and misunderstand him. Deep inside, he has a really innocent personality. His soft and cute voice often gets him cast as prepubescent boys or kids' anime roles. He's a big fan of Haato.
